meaning: Physics VIII.4's closing argument (255b31-256a3) on the literal reading of its last step, for physical motion. Not a transcription: the conclusion is derived by a two-level case analysis, and premisesNeeded shows each of the five premises is needed. literalReadingDoesNotGivePerSeMover shows that this literal reading does not yield even STMT-EVERY-PHYSICAL-MOTION-HAS-A-PER-SE-MOVER: a light thing moved only by the remover of a hindrance has no per se mover. Connects results; closes nothing.
